contents.design: Queen proposes a one-step next-turn collection from a complete small donor after projecting her current confirmed move; donor rechecks current allied Queen adjacency, same-round message, own complete body, population and visible competition. Intentional self-neck collision is recorded as a capital transfer sacrifice; at most length3 and never Queen/last survivor.
limitations: Sonar does not authenticate sender; message is only a proposal, geometry and opportunity must independently hold.
